title: Tarred

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Tarred is a status effect that slows the player down. It is inflicted by Growths or by swimming in a Tar pit.
It slows the player by 50% and makes them very weak to fire damage. The effect lasts 10 seconds.
